nodes.description: Public mapping holding token balances of UniswapExchange; updated with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping storing spend allowances; written in constructor and approve/transferFrom.
Private mapping counting how many sales an address has performed; consumed by condition().
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition check.
Private minimum sale value set by init(); read by condition().
Private maximum sale value set by init(); read by condition().
Private maximum number of sales per address set by init(); read by condition().
Address set by setTradeAddress() that bypasses the sale condition in ensure().
Privileged owner address set in constructor; guards delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Public total supply, assigned in constructor.
UniswapExchange constructor: sets name/symbol/supply, owner = msg.sender and infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer routine; mutates allowance/balanceOf/_onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Whitelist gate: returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale senders, otherwise enforces condition().
Enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits on a transfer.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to _value.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall target execution.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked scaling multiplication.
Owner-only mass transfer loop; computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress, another whitelist bypass path.
Deterministic Uniswap pair address computation using create2 hashing.
SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level external call to a token address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance accounting and transfers.
Low-level delegatecall to a caller-supplied address inside delegate().

Low-level address(token).call(data) external call in callOptionalReturn.

edges.reason: Recipient parameter _to is consumed by transfer().
Amount parameter _value is consumed by transfer().
msg.sender is used as the _from address inside transfer().
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Source parameter _from drives allowance and balance accounting.
Recipient parameter _to receives the credited balance.
Amount parameter _value drives allowance and balance mutation.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether allowance is spent.
balanceOf mapping is read to validate the sender balance.
allowance mapping is read to validate and decrement the spender allowance.
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction reachable from attacker-controlled input.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is an unchecked addition that can overflow.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] before the Transfer event.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to pass.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
Owner address short-circuits ensure() and bypasses condition().
canSale whitelist lets an address bypass the sale condition check.
tradeAddress is a privileged bypass address in ensure().
ensure() calls condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address through pairFor().
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer value.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer value.
condition() reads _saleNum to enforce the per-address sale limit.
Spender parameter _spender is written into the allowance mapping by approve().
Amount parameter _value is written into the allowance mapping by approve().
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve().
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Address parameter a is the delegatecall target supplied by the caller.
Bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload supplied by the caller.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary code.
owner state variable gates the delegate() entry point.
delegate() performs a delegatecall to a caller-supplied address, executing code in this contract's storage context.
saleNum parameter configures _saleNum in init().
token parameter configures _minSale in init().
maxToken parameter configures _maxSale in init().
init() is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
owner state variable gates init().
_minSale = token*(10**decimals) uses unchecked multiplication.
_maxSale = maxToken*(10**decimals) uses unchecked multiplication.
init() assigns _saleNum.
Destination array _tos drives the batchSend() loop and total computation.
Per-recipient _value drives the total and balance credits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner and debits the caller balance.
owner state variable gates batchSend().
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend().
total = _value * _tos.length can overflow for large arrays or values.
The unchecked product becomes the local total used for balance validation.
Local total is compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] to allow the batch debit.
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
owner state variable gates setTradeAddress().
setTradeAddress() writes tradeAddress, granting a condition bypass in ensure().
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call to an arbitrary token before state is finalized.
Constructor stores msg.sender as owner and grants it totalSupply plus infinite allowance.
Constructor assigns the privileged owner variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router address.
